planned_change: Keep legacy semantics; add separate opt-in constructor only in future implementation.
Carry immutable mode, origin and arena control block across transfer.
Explicit leases; retirement while borrowed defers exactly one release; close rejects import but keeps retained roots safe.
Single arena, semantic counters, states and variable cleanup; keep legacy remove branch.
Object slot lease and one creator lease per head; physical Rc count is not semantic count.
Actual stable slots own payload; aliases and snapshots do not duplicate it.
Independent counter leases; acquire new owners before releasing overwritten payloads.
Preserve preflight and atomic rejection, stable capture cells, graph checks and publication boundary.
Frame exec leases; unwind once; sticky failure does not imply implicit drain; preflight restart before mutation.
Retain graph restrictions; no full GC or escaping capture references.
Lifecycle opt-in grants no capture permission; direct Object/Function captures remain gated.
